title: Barotropic beta-plane and homomorphic quotient-filter negative-control ablation

arms.purpose: Prove that the beta-dependent term changes the trajectory.
Negative control for the homomorphic filter that admits every exact triad.

acceptance_criteria: Every run remains finite and satisfies energy and enstrophy budget residuals below 1e-6 absolute.
At every matched configuration the beta-plane and f-plane vorticity fields differ by more than 1e-6 in relative L2 norm.
At every matched configuration the quotient-filter and identity fields agree within 1e-12 maximum absolute error.
Halving the time step changes final energy, enstrophy, and zonal energy fraction by less than 2 percent at fixed grid and seed.
rejection_criteria: Reject the implementation if beta does not alter the evolution or if the quotient negative control changes it.

Reject any jet claim unless final-window mean and tenth-percentile zonal energy each reach 10 percent, fixed peak prominence reaches 5 percent of initial RMS speed, modal jet count is at least two, and count occupancy reaches 80 percent.
Reject convergence claims when the preregistered refinement threshold fails; report the values as finite-resolution diagnostics.
